description: Free public methodology and comparable coverage for every CoinRithm prediction-market venue: source kind, supported metrics, market counts, explicit 24h/cumulative volume bases, currency basis, comparability, and as-of timestamps. Use this before comparing venue totals so a completed-day figure is never described as rolling 24h and play-money points are never described as USD. No API key required.

fiat.description: Fiat currency code for monetary figures (default usd).

name: pm_data_sources

body.description: Parsed CoinRithm response body, or raw text when the response is not JSON.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status returned by CoinRithm, or 0 for network errors.

ledgerEventId.description: Private AgentActionEvent id returned by /api/agent/*, when present.

ledgerStatus.description: Ledger write status header returned by CoinRithm, when present.

ok.description: True when CoinRithm returned a successful 2xx response.

title: Prediction-market venue methodology and coverage
